out.text: Maya Sharma (HLG-P1047)'s records don't include a HbA1c result. Page 4 shows HbA1c 6.9 %, but that belongs to a different person with the same name, Maya Sharma (HLG-P1048, born 04 Dec 1968), so I haven't used it.

out.ask: What should I ask her doctor?
out.text: Questions you could bring to their doctor about Maya Sharma's report, each from a line in these reports: 1) Ferritin was corrected from 5 to 50 in an amended report: which value should we go by? 2) TSH 6.8 mIU/L (above the 0.4 to 4.5 range): what does that mean for me? 3) Creatinine (serum) 99 µmol/L (above the 45 to 90 range): what does that mean for me? 4) Hemoglobin 11.1 g/dL (below the 12.0 to 16.0 range): what does that mean for me? 5) Creatinine (serum) was printed in different units in two reports: has it actually changed? These are questions to ask, not a diagnosis. (That is HLG-P1047's record. Page 4 is a different person with the same name, HLG-P1048; I left it out.)
